verdict.rationale: RudderStack ships its own AI features that produce insights from workspace data: root-cause analysis of destination delivery errors, detection of duplicate or typo event names, and an AI-powered Rudder AI agent. These are delivered through Slack and external MCP clients (Claude, Cursor, etc.) rather than shown inside the RudderStack app, and the homepage claim about AI chat interfaces for analyzing customer data is thinly documented. missing for 10: documented in-app AI insights surface, proactive suggestions over customer/event data, depth of the analytics-insight capability beyond pipeline debugging, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Investigate destination delivery errors and get root cause analysis
Detect duplicate or similar event names across sources
Rudder AI Manage and interact with your workspace via an AI-powered agent in Slack
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
AI powered chat interfaces give everyone safe, on demand access to rich customer context and empower business teams to analyze, segment, and activate data
